_warning: Sources locales mixent Sartorius Group consolidated (parent, listed Frankfurt) et Sartorius Stedim Biotech S.A. (subsidiary, listed Paris DIM.PA). sources_used: sec-data/cat3-european/DIM.PA/annual-text/2023.txt (Annual Report FY22 Sartorius Group key figures FY18-FY22)
_ordering_rationale: BPS Division = ~80% du CA Sartorius Group. KPIs operationnels lecture biotech bioprocess.

kpis.signal: Recovery post normalisation Covid (cycle vendor de-stock 2023-2024 fini)
kpis.description_fr: CA Q1 2026 de la division Bioprocess Solutions de Sartorius Group (>75% CA Group). Croissance +8.1% en devises constantes. Consommables + equipements pour bioprocessing biopharma.
kpis.description_en: Q1 2026 revenue of Sartorius Group Bioprocess Solutions Division (>75% of Group sales). +8.1% growth in constant currencies. Consumables + equipment for biopharma bioprocessing.

kpis.signal: Marge BPS Q1 2026 ~31.7% (233M EBITDA / 735M revenue). Group margin 29.7%
kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITDA sous-jacente division Bioprocess Solutions. EBITDA Q1 2026 = 233M€ (+3.4%) sur revenu 735M€. Targets management >32% FY26.
kpis.description_en: BPS Division underlying EBITDA margin. Q1 2026 EBITDA = €233M (+3.4%) on €735M revenue. FY26 management target >32%.

kpis.signal: Q1 2026 +7.5%, contribution MATTEK (acquired Jul 2025) = +0.5 pts. Toutes regions positives.
kpis.description_fr: CA Sartorius Group Q1 2026. EMEA 392M (+8.0%), Americas 308M (+6.0%), APAC 199M (+8.9%). Mgmt guide FY26 growth high single digit constant currency.
kpis.description_en: Sartorius Group Q1 2026 revenue. EMEA €392M (+8.0%), Americas €308M (+6.0%), APAC €199M (+8.9%). FY26 guidance: high single digit constant currency.

kpis.signal: ~80% revenu recurrent (consommables single-use bioprocess). Moat structurel pure-play.
kpis.description_fr: Part du CA Sartorius Group provenant de revenus recurrents (consommables single-use, media, filtration). Structure 'razor/blade' propre au bioprocess.
kpis.description_en: Share of Sartorius Group revenue from recurring revenues (single-use consumables, media, filtration). 'Razor/blade' structure inherent to bioprocess.

kpis.signal: Marge Group Q1 2026 = 29.7% (vs 29.8% Q1 2025). Tres resilient malgre tariffs US.

kpis.description_en: Sartorius Group underlying EBITDA margin Q1 2026. EBITDA €267M (+1.6%) on €899M revenue. LT management target >35%.
